claims.exact_statement: For every surjective L:F_2^n->F_2^r and every nonempty B subset F_2^r with p=|B|/2^r<=1/2, let M be the number of nonzero Fourier coefficients of 1_B. If log_2(2M-1)<=2log_2(1/p)+1, then K(x,z)=1-2 1_{x=-1}1_{Lz in B} satisfies H(K)<6 I(K).
hypotheses: n and r are positive integers and L:F_2^n->F_2^r is surjective
B is a nonempty subset of F_2^r
M is the exact number of nonzero normalized Fourier coefficients of 1_B
x is one fresh physical selector coordinate
entropy and influence use the uniform cube and base-2 logarithms
